Subject: [opensuse] Connect to Internet through a cell phone?

Hello,

I've spent three weeks off and on trying to get my laptop (openSuSE 10.3) to 
connect to the internet through my cell phone.

For the most part, I've been trying to use umtsmon, as suggested in the 
opensuse Wiki.

I've tried both bluetooth and USB cable. umtsmon authors are not sure why it 
doesn't work (I've been asking on the umtsmon mailing list).

My current cell phone is a Nokia 6555, I'm with AT&T (former Cingular) and 
have the unlimited "DataConnect" plan. It works fine on OS X through 
bluetooth, and also works fine with my HP iPaq (Windows Mobile 2003). So I 
know the phone works ok. I'm not able to make the Mac connect using the USB 
cable, but that might just be because I don't know what I'm doing. It works 
just fine using bluetooth.

At this point I'm not so worried about making umtsmon work, I just want some 
way to connect, doesn't matter what combination of scripts and software I 
use, or even if I need to get a different cell phone. 

Has *anyone* in the U.S.A been able to make their SuSE connect to the internet 
through their mobile phone? If so, what did you do to make it work?

Thanks,

	JW
